verdict.rationale: Expensify's docs describe a full real-time coding pipeline — SmartScan auto-extracts merchant/date/total, AI auto-categorizes and tags expenses, multi-level GL coding, and automatic export to QuickBooks/NetSuite — which is exactly the 'code as it happens' close-readiness story. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the categorization claim, citing ~70% miscategorization rates and slow/manual processing, meaning finance teams still have real cleanup work at month-end rather than pure review. Missing for 10: independent verification that categorization/AI accuracy has materially improved since these reports, and evidence of end-to-end audit showing memo/receipt completeness at scale without manual correction.
